# Collaboration blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Collaboration blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## comments

Comments on any record as its conversation on the messaging core: whoever reads the record reads them, with replies, mentions and mention groups, anchors, files, edits with history, pins, resolved threads and read markers. The author and the mentioned follow the record and its followers hear of new comments (with notifications), and a comment becomes a work item (with tasks).

- Title: Comments
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/comments
- Client: `commentsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/comments`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `messaging`
- Works with: `notifications`, `tasks`, `reactions`, `attachments`, `subjects`
- Consumes: `attachments (optional)`

## attachments

Files linked to records in a tenant: a record per file, a private bucket whose policies only accept an upload a pending record expects, and reads only for scanned files. confirm_attachment() emits attachment.uploaded for the app's scan job. options.publicBuckets serves chosen buckets by public URL, for media such as product images.

- Title: Attachments
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/attachments
- Client: `attachmentsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/attachments`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `profiles`, `subjects`, `imports`
- Entities: `attachment`
- Tables: `attachments`
- Permission keys: `attachments.read`, `attachments.upload`, `attachments.manage`
- Events (`AttachmentsEvents`): `attachment.replaced`, `attachment.restored`, `attachment.scanned`, `attachment.uploaded`
- Provides: `attachments`

## share-links

Hashed share links, view counts and per-user state. The token is returned once. Resolving a link hashes the token the caller presents, so a stored plaintext token keeps working after it is hashed. A link can take a password, checked with bcrypt and rate-limited per link, and turn off downloads.

- Title: Share links
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/share-links
- Client: `shareLinksBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/share-links`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `versions`, `subjects`, `rate-limit`
- Entities: `share_link`
- Tables: `share_links`
- Permission keys: `share_links.create`, `share_links.read`
- Events (`ShareLinksEvents`): `share_link.created`, `share_link.revoked`, `subject.viewed`

## reactions

Emoji reactions and up or down votes on any subject and on messages, with per-tenant custom emoji, counts and a vote score per subject under the subject's own read rules and a realtime topic per tenant.

- Title: Reactions
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/reactions
- Client: `reactionsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/reactions`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `messaging`
- Entities: `reaction`
- Tables: `reactions`
- Permission keys: `reactions.read`, `reactions.create`, `reactions.manage`
- Events (`ReactionsEvents`): `reaction.added`, `reaction.deleted`

## moderation

Reports on any subject, a review queue, decisions (approve, hide, remove, restore, ban) with a log, user bans and an automatic hide threshold. Reviews moderate through it, and it hides and removes messages, comments included.

- Title: Moderation
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/moderation
- Client: `moderationBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/moderation`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `messaging`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `moderation_item`
- Tables: `moderation_items`
- Permission keys: `moderation.read`, `moderation.report`, `moderation.manage`, `moderation.ban`
- Events (`ModerationEvents`): `moderation_appeal.decided`, `moderation_appeal.filed`, `moderation_ban.created`, `moderation_ban.lifted`, `moderation_item.decided`, `moderation_notice.decided`, `moderation_notice.received`, `moderation_report.created`, `moderation_statement.issued`

## guests

People outside the organization (clients, contractors) invited by email who read, comment on and upload to the records they are granted, and see the invoices and bookings of the party they act for. Never members, never through an authorization library.

- Title: Guests
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/guests
- Client: `guestsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/guests`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `invoices`, `bookings`, `contacts`, `relations`
- Entities: `guest`, `guest_grant`
- Tables: `guests`, `guest_grants`
- Permission keys: `guests.read`, `guests.manage`
- Events (`GuestsEvents`): `guest.accepted`, `guest.invited`, `guest.revoked`, `guest_grant.created`, `guest_grant.revoked`

## messaging

Conversations and messages shared by channels, record discussions and the inbox: channels, direct and group messages, one conversation per record, members with read markers and notification levels, threads, mentions, edits with history, pins, resolved threads, scheduled sends, files and reactions. Members, the tenant or the record's readers read a conversation; Realtime pings carry ids only.

- Title: Messaging
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/messaging
- Client: `messagingBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/messaging`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `notifications`, `queue`, `profiles`, `attachments`, `reactions`, `data-lifecycle`, `inbox`, `moderation`
- Entities: `message`, `conversation`
- Tables: `messages`, `conversations`
- Permission keys: `messages.read`, `messages.send`, `messages.moderate`
- Events (`MessagingEvents`): `conversation.archived`, `conversation.created`, `conversation.member_added`, `conversation.member_removed`, `conversation.restored`, `message.deleted`, `message.pinned`, `message.resolved`, `message.sent`, `message.updated`

## channels

Named conversations on the messaging core: public channels anyone in the tenant reads and joins, private ones for their members, each with a topic, a purpose and an optional linked record. Create, rename, join, leave and browse; messages, threads, typing and read markers come from messaging.

- Title: Channels
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/channels
- Client: `channelsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/channels`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `messaging`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `data-lifecycle`
- Entities: `channel`
- Tables: `channels`
- Permission keys: `messages.read`, `channels.create`, `channels.manage`
- Events (`ChannelsEvents`): `channel.created`, `channel.updated`

## timeline

A timeline_entries feed that activitySink() fills from outbox events, filtered by can_subject and joined with the subject's audit entries, notification deliveries and workflow runs when subjects, audit, notifications and workflows are installed.

- Title: Activity feed
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/timeline
- Client: `timelineBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/timeline`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `notifications`, `subjects`, `audit`, `workflows`, `state-machine`, `messaging`
- Entities: `timeline_entry`
- Tables: `timeline_entries`
- Permission keys: `timeline.read`

## posts

Forum threads and feedback posts on boards. Replies are comments on the messaging core, votes are reactions, and each post is a moderation item members can report. Feedback posts move through a status from open to done.

- Title: Posts
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/posts
- Client: `postsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/posts`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `messaging`, `comments`, `reactions`, `moderation`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `post_board`, `post`
- Tables: `post_boards`, `posts`
- Permission keys: `posts.read`, `posts.write`, `posts.moderate`, `posts.manage`
- Events (`PostsEvents`): `post.archived`, `post.created`, `post.merged`, `post.moderated`, `post.purged`, `post.restored`, `post.status_changed`, `post.updated`, `post_board.created`, `post_board.updated`

## acknowledgements

Members confirm they read the current version of a record: assignments to a member, a team or a role, a due date per assignment, a click or a completed signature, and a reminder once a version is overdue.

- Title: Acknowledgements
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/acknowledgements
- Client: `acknowledgementsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/acknowledgements`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `versions`
- Works with: `subjects`, `teams`, `signatures`, `notifications`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `acknowledgement`, `acknowledgement_assignment`
- Tables: `acknowledgements`, `acknowledgement_assignments`
- Permission keys: `acknowledgements.read`, `acknowledgements.manage`, `acknowledgements.acknowledge`
- Events (`AcknowledgementsEvents`): `acknowledgement.created`, `acknowledgement.reminded`, `acknowledgement_assignment.created`, `acknowledgement_assignment.deleted`

## meetings

Meetings with an agenda, attendees and roles, minutes per agenda item, decisions the attendees vote on, and action items that become tasks.

- Title: Meetings
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/meetings
- Client: `meetingsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/meetings`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`, `tasks`
- Works with: `reactions`, `documents`, `calendar`, `notifications`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `meeting`, `meeting_attendee`, `meeting_agenda_item`, `meeting_decision`, `meeting_action_item`
- Tables: `meetings`, `meeting_attendees`, `meeting_agenda_items`, `meeting_decisions`, `meeting_action_items`
- Permission keys: `meetings.read`, `meetings.write`, `meetings.manage`
- Events (`MeetingsEvents`): `meeting.archived`, `meeting.cancelled`, `meeting.concluded`, `meeting.created`, `meeting.purged`, `meeting.restored`, `meeting.started`, `meeting.updated`, `meeting_action_item.created`, `meeting_decision.decided`, `meeting_decision.recorded`
